# Vendored NTQR

`ntqr-0.9-py2.py3-none-any.whl` is the unmodified [published NTQR 0.9 wheel](https://pypi.org/project/ntqr/0.9/).
SHA-256: `83f3cbeeb54eb6a86fb1df8a7c86187f8b14511d69de94d3527ebe49d0a931d8`.
It retains the upstream MIT license and attribution. The local wheel source
avoids the historical source-distribution packaging failure and allows locked,
offline wheel resolution. `uv.lock` verifies its content. See
[the migration notes](../docs/dependencies.md) for compatibility and provenance.
